title: The Battle of the Mind
seo_description: Every battle starts in the mind. A devotional for men on 2 Corinthians 10:5: how to take toxic thoughts captive before they become chains.
verse_text: We take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
insight: Every battle starts in the mind. 2 Corinthians 10:5 reminds us that victory begins with capturing toxic thoughts and submitting them to Christ.
Thoughts left unchecked turn into chains. When you take them captive, you break the enemy’s grip before it tightens.
one_minute_win: Write down one recurring lie, then cross it out and replace it with truth.
declaration: My mind belongs to Christ, not lies.
related_devotionals: Philippians 4:8 Devotional - Think on These Things
